caption: The drawing depicts a single dress with short puffed sleeves and a square neckline. The dress is predominantly light in color, with alternating horizontal bands of thin, light gray or blue stripes and darker decorative patterns consisting of small, repeating circular or oval motifs. The sleeves and bodice are gathered at the top and waist, creating a slightly fitted look. The dress has a high waistline and a long, gently flared skirt that reaches ankle length. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or details. The entire composition centers the dress in the frame, displayed without any visible hanger, mannequin, or human figure.
title: Child's Dress
